name: 薄骨片完整态
pivotSuggestion: top-center for hanging pieces; contact top-center for terrain; center for landmarks
qaFindings: 完整薄骨轮廓明显薄于稳定骨台，顶面略带粉色残留；暂未出现裂纹，用作后续两态同尺寸基准。
需root完成统一比例、透明深浅底和确定性房间合成验收；未作为已验收入库。

generationRequest.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated 2D game environment sprite on genuinely TRANSPARENT background, reference-guided redraw. Image1 supplies intended organ material and shape language; Image2 is the established delivered asset's matte gouache, clean dark ink contours, fine hand-painted texture and side-view only, do not copy its anatomy. Side-scrolling camera, very slight top-face visibility only where appropriate. Draw one complete coherent object with about 8% clear transparent padding, no scene, no floating multiple objects, no contact shadow or colored haze outside the silhouette. Full object uncropped. No characters, creatures, shelters, lamps, red ropes, rewards, symbols, labels, UI, ground patch, water or backdrop. No human stonework or invented portals.  Subject: ONE fragile thin bone plank for dead whale R4, intact BASE state. A single narrow long flat old ivory bone shard with continuous horizontal top contact edge and a very thin tapered underside, five hero units wide, approximately 7:1 silhouette ratio. Cool gray shadows and fine small natural pores. One subtle worn weak spot in the central third but NO fracture yet. Entire left and right ends complete and softly chipped; thin plate thickness clearly much less than stable bone platform. No attached ropes, rings, knots, fungi, objects, glow, markings or dust. Full independent sprite centered with equal transparent padding, recordable fixed geometry for future alternate cracked and broken states.

method: 内置 imagegen 逐件生成或参考引导静态状态修改；原始 PNG 未裁切、降噪或抠图。
